integrity: The package includes a self-contained proof and executable finite-case checker. No independent audit, novelty certification, external proof assistant or all-parameter computation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced varieties for nilpotent centralizers of Jordan type (n-2,2), n>=5, and raw ordered tuple counts. Full earlier literature and independent verification remain open.
title: A sharp reducibility threshold for nilpotent two-block centralizers
